title: Time Ago Display
content: Implement relative time display for dates. Use library like date-fns (formatDistanceToNow) or Intl.RelativeTimeFormat. Display patterns: "just now" (<1 min), "5 minutes ago", "2 hours ago", "yesterday", "3 days ago", "last week", "2 weeks ago", "Dec 15". Threshold: switch to absolute date after ~7 days or month. Tooltip: show full date/time on hover. Auto-update: optionally refresh display every minute for recent items. Locale: respect user locale for formatting. Handle future dates: "in 2 hours", "tomorrow". Edge cases: invalid dates, timezone handling.

variants.simple: Display dates as relative time like "2 hours ago" or "yesterday".

variants.advanced: Implement relative time display for dates with auto-updating and locale support. Library options: date-fns formatDistanceToNow (lightweight, tree-shakeable), dayjs with relativeTime plugin, Intl.RelativeTimeFormat (native, limited but zero-dep). Display thresholds: <1 minute: "just now", <60 minutes: "X minutes ago", <24 hours: "X hours ago", yesterday: "yesterday", <7 days: "X days ago", <30 days: "last week"/"2 weeks ago", older: absolute date (Dec 15, 2024). Short format option: "5m", "2h", "3d" for compact displays. Tooltip: title attribute or custom tooltip with full datetime ("December 15, 2024 at 3:45 PM"). Auto-update: useEffect with setInterval to refresh every 60 seconds for items <1 hour old, clean up interval on unmount. Future dates: "in 5 minutes", "tomorrow", "in 2 weeks". Locale: Intl.RelativeTimeFormat respects locale, or date-fns with locale import. Implementation: custom hook useTimeAgo(date) returning formatted string, or component <TimeAgo date={timestamp} />. Edge cases: handle null/undefined dates, invalid dates, very old dates (years ago), timezone conversions. Accessibility: datetime attribute on time element for machine-readable date. SSR: handle hydration mismatch (dates differ server vs client), consider suppressHydrationWarning or client-only rendering.
